BURSEVI:v6p216/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p216/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p216/r3.claim: The temporal clause gives the extended period of denial; “their brother” is by lineage, not religion.
BURSEVI:v6p216/r3.anchor: ثم بين الوقت الممتد للتكذيب المستمر فقال : {إذ قال لهم أخوهم} النسبي لا الديني فإن الأنبياء محفوظون قبل النبوة معصومون بعدها

BURSEVI:v6p216/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p216/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p216/r4.claim: The lineage term does not compromise prophetic protection: prophets are preserved before their mission and infallible afterward.
BURSEVI:v6p216/r4.anchor: فإن الأنبياء محفوظون قبل النبوة معصومون بعدها

BURSEVI:v6p216/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p216/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p216/r5.claim: Calling Ṣāliḥ their brother lets them know his trustworthiness and language, helping them understand and believe his message.
BURSEVI:v6p216/r5.anchor: وفائدة كونه منهم أن تعرف أمانته ولغته فيؤدي ذلك إلى فهم ما جاء به وتصديقه

BURSEVI:v6p216/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p216/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p216/r6.claim: Ṣāliḥ is identified as the son of ʿUbayd ibn Āṣif ibn Kāshiḥ ibn Ḥāḏir ibn Thamūd.
BURSEVI:v6p216/r6.anchor: {صالح} ابن عبيد بن آسف بن كاشح بن حاذر بن ثمود

BURSEVI:v6p216/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p216/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p216/r7.claim: Ṣāliḥ asks whether they fear God’s punishment for associating partners with Him.
BURSEVI:v6p216/r7.anchor: {ألا تتقون} (أيا نمي ترسيد از عذاب خداي كه بدو شرك مي آريد)

STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.claim: The opening of Ṣāliḥ's story repeats the pattern used for other prophets, as discussed for Noah.
STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.anchor: For a similar opening to other prophets’ stories, cf. vv. 105–9, 123–27, 160–64, 176–80.

TAB-FULL:v17p618/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p618/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p618/r1.claim: Thamūd denied the messengers when Ṣāliḥ, their brother, called them to fear God’s punishment for disobedience and following corrupt people.
TAB-FULL:v17p618/r1.anchor: إذ دعاهم صالح أخوهم إلى الله، فقال لهم: ألا تتقون عقاب الله يا قوم على معصيتكم إياه

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r4.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r4.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r4.claim: Ṣāliḥ is their brother by lineage, not by religion.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r4.anchor: {إذ قال لهم أخوهم صالح} [الشعراء: 142] أخوهم في النسب وليس بأخيهم في الدين.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r5.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r5.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r5.claim: The appeal tells them to fear God, as in the earlier account.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r5.anchor: {ألا تتقون} [الشعراء: 106] الله، وهي مثل الأولى، يأمرهم أن يتقوا الله.

ELMALILI:26:141-159/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:141-159/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:141-159/r1.claim: Ṣāliḥ asks his people whether they will not fear God.
ELMALILI:26:141-159/r1.anchor: O vakit ki kardeşleri Sâlih onlara demişti: “Allah’tan korkmaz mısınız? (142).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r2.claim: Salih was sent as a prophet to convey God’s religion to Thamud.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r2.anchor: Hz. Sâlih bu kabileye Allah’ın dinini tebliğ etmek üzere gönderilmiş bir peygamberdir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r3.claim: The Qur’an recounts Salih’s story in many places, highlighting different aspects in each telling.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r3.anchor: Kıssası Kur’an’da birçok yerde anlatılmış olup her geçtiği yerde kıssanın farklı yönleri ön plana çıkarılmıştır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r4.claim: This telling warns against arrogance based on power and wealth, stresses worldly life’s transience, and points to accountability in the hereafter.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:141/r4.anchor: Burada insanların güç ve servetine güvenerek şımarmalarının doğru olmadığı, dünya hayatının geçici olduğu ve âhirette hesaba çekilecekleri vurgulanmıştır

ASAD-NOTES:26:141#n62/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:26:141#n62/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:26:141#n62/r1.claim: Asad refers readers to the account of Salih and Thamud at 7:73 and to the version at 2:61–68.
ASAD-NOTES:26:141#n62/r1.anchor: For the story of Salih and the tribe of Thamud, see 7:73 and the corresponding note 56; also, the version appearing in ii: 61-68.

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r1.claim: Samarrāʾī distinguishes Midian from the Aykah people: Shuaib belonged to Midian, so he is called their brother when addressing Midian but not Aykah; the other Shuʿara prophets address their own peoples.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r1.anchor: ومدين غير أصحاب الأيكة، وشعيب عليه السلام كان من مدين ولم يكن من أصحاب الأيكة ولذلك إذا ذكرت مدين قال: (أخوهم)

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.claim: Ṣāliḥ’s opening appeal repeats the formulation used at the end of the preceding prophetic account, where it was already explained.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.anchor: Precisely these verses have been mentioned at end of the last anecdote and they have been explained there.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r2.claim: Ṣāliḥ declares that he is no false prophet or bluffer but God’s trustworthy messenger, faithfully conveying His message.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r2.anchor: Ṣāliḥ (sws) said that he is not a false prophet and is not bluffing them.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r25.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r25.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r25.claim: Salih was known to them for truthfulness, trustworthiness, compassion, and integrity.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r25.anchor: الذي يعرفون صدقه وأمانته , وشفقته وصيانته

BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r26.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r26.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r26.claim: Salih begins with a gentle, invitational appeal asking whether they will take heed.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p378/r26.anchor: أشار إلى تلطفه بهم بقوله على سبيل العرض

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r1.claim: Qatada says Salih was sent from al-Hijr.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r1.anchor: قتادة : ان صالحا بعث من الحجر

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas recounts that Salih's people first believed, then abandoned Islam after his death; God revived and recommissioned him, they demanded a sign, and after the she-camel came they disbelieved, hamstrung it, and were destroyed.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2800#2/r2.anchor: ابن عباس ان صالح النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بعثه الله إلى قومه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p175/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p175/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p175/r1.claim: The later speech explains the rebuke in ألا تتقون: their current way of life will not last, since they will leave this world and return to God.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p175/r1.anchor: لأن الإنكار عليهم دوام حالهم يقتضي أنهم مفارقون هذه الحياة وصائرون إلى الله

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p239#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p239#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p239#2/r3.claim: Ṣāliḥ is called their brother by lineage.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p239#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p239#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p239#2/r4.claim: The Arab prophets are Hūd, Ṣāliḥ, Shuʿayb, and Muḥammad; Ismāʿīl spoke Arabic but had Syriac ancestry and fathered the Arabs living today.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p239#2/r4.anchor: والأنبياء من العرب أربعة هود وصالح وشعيب ومحمد عليهم السلام، وإسماعيل عليه السلام عربي اللسان سرياني النسب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r1.claim: Ṣāliḥ was God's servant and messenger, sent to the Arab people of Thamūd, who lived at al-Ḥijr between Wādī al-Qurā and Syria.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r1.anchor: بعثه إلى قوم ثمود، وكانوا عربا يسكنون مدينة الحجر، التي بين وادي القرى وبلاد الشام

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r2.claim: The Prophet passed by Thamūd while heading on a campaign toward Syria, reached Tabūk, then returned to Medina to prepare for it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r2.anchor: الأحاديث المروية في مرور رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r3.claim: Thamūd came after ʿĀd and before Abraham; Ṣāliḥ called them to worship God alone and obey the message, but they rejected and opposed him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r3.anchor: وقد كانوا بعد عاد وقبل الخليل، عليه السلام.

JISHUMI:v7p5377/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5377/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5377/r10.claim: Ṣāliḥ is their brother in lineage; his appeal asks whether they will not fear God's punishment.
JISHUMI:v7p5377/r10.anchor: إذ قال لهم أخوهم في النسب صالح ألا تتقون عذاب الله

MUQATIL:26:141-153/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r2.claim: Ṣalih was their brother by lineage.
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r2.anchor: فى النسب، وليس بأخيهم فى الدنيا

MUQATIL:26:141-153/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r3.claim: “Will you not be God-conscious?” means “Will you not fear God?”
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r3.anchor: يعنى ألا تخشون الله عز وجل
